desc: A burial mound, in granite. It looks very old. Here: pots, beads and bronze. Purple anemone, in flower. Young animals. The sky is clear, afternoon. The air is cool. Here and there: bare earth. The plain town to the west (middle).

features.name: pots, beads, bronze
features.note: Mentioned but not examinable; dig found nothing.

name: Burial mound
notes: A short walk south of the grassland (from "go back"). "go north" from here walked a long way, past the grassland, to the flowering ash. Dig found nothing; no marks.
statusNote: Looked until nothing new; no writing; dig found nothing. Come back if we find a way to reach the pots, beads and bronze.
